visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black short-sleeved t-shirt stands centrally, holding two clear glass bowls of soup containing pink and white tangyuan with grey insulated oven mitts. Two women, one in a light blue sweater and one in a grey top, enter from the sides, smiling and pointing at the bowls. The background is a white-walled kitchen with a black wine rack. (2) The scene shifts to close-up shots of food preparation in a well-lit indoor kitchen. A woman in a blue sweater chops mushrooms and carrots on a green cutting board while the man watches. Hands are shown peeling plastic off ingredients and placing small tangyuan into a metal strainer before dipping them into a pot of boiling water. (3) The man stir-fries minced meat, dried shrimp, and sliced mushrooms in a white ceramic wok using a wooden spatula. He adds chopped green onions from a small bowl and pours a liquid from a can into the mixture. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the sizzling ingredients. (4) In an office setting, various individuals are shown eating the prepared soup from small grey bowls. A woman in a grey hoodie smiles broadly after taking a bite. A man in a grey sweatshirt is shown in a close-up, tasting the broth carefully with a spoon. The background includes office desks and professional photography lighting. (5) The final phase shows a group of eight people standing behind a long wooden table in the office. They all hold their soup bowls and wave enthusiastically at the camera. The man from the first phase is in the center, leading the collective gesture of celebration and joy.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 冬至就是要吃鹹湯圓！[Logo]: 77BOSS. [Variety]: 甜湯圓. 鹹湯圓. 選哪個！ (2) [Subtitle]: 誰要吃鹹的啦～！甜的比較好吃. [Variety]: 七嘴八舌. (3) [Subtitle]: 冬至要到啦！今年大家過得如何？不管是你是老闆很機掰... 我先教你怎麼切. 我可是屏東小廚娘. 你教我怎麼切？ (4) [Variety]: 嫌棄！ [Subtitle]: 還是男友超靠杯, 日子多坎坷QQ. 至少你要吃顆圓的. 假裝一下今年還算圓滿吧. (5) [Subtitle]: 我們客家人冬至是一定要吃鹹湯圓！ [Variety]: 一定要吃鹹湯圓！ (6) [Subtitle]: 首先先加入瘦肉、香菇、油蔥、蝦米. 先把香氣炒出來. 再加入蔥花、胡椒去調味. 再用高湯慢慢燉煮. 然後接著丟進湯圓. (7) [Subtitle]: 看起來它是非常樸實, 但吃一口你就知道啦. 這不只是湯圓. 這叫「鄉愁」. (8) [Subtitle]: 感覺可以加一點小米酒...... 今年冬至我特別準備了一鍋鹹湯圓、一鍋甜湯圓. (9) [Subtitle]: 做給我們辦公室的小夥伴吃. 希望大家工作再累, 至少胃是暖的, 人是圓的. (10) [Subtitle]: 這個比較好. 我覺得以前的鹹湯圓都白吃了. [Variety]: 狗腿 XD. 太浮誇了～ [Subtitle]: 同事們嫌棄. (11) [Subtitle]: 今年你們吃湯圓了嗎？喜歡甜的還是鹹的, 歡迎留言告訴我. 也懇請明年繼續支持我們吧！ [Variety]: 耶.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video celebrates the Winter Solstice (Dongzhi) by showing the creator cooking traditional Hakka savory tangyuan and sharing it with his office colleagues to foster a warm, communal atmosphere. It also serves as a lifestyle vlog and brand promotion for '77BOSS'.
